findings.finding: Stated 'CI passes' is false assurance: .github/workflows/ci.yml is `sleep 20 && exit 0` and never inspects the file.
findings.answer: Acceptance is a file-content check run against the PR head, not CI: `test -f smoke/S395289629-5.md && head -1 smoke/S395289629-5.md | grep -q 'S395289629-5'`. Code-settled technical check in the planner's lane; the spec names no CI surface.

findings.finding: First-line content convention is undefined; repo shows bare-key, boilerplate-title, and descriptive-sentence styles.
findings.answer: Use the bare issue key `S395289629-5`, matching the nearest sibling leaf smoke/S393243811-5.md and the spec's literal 'single line that names this issue'. Cosmetic; all forms satisfy acceptance.

findings.finding: Review-append scope says 'one more line' (singular) but prior markers carry up to three review-round lines.
findings.answer: The parent spec authorizes appended review lines as in scope; each review round may append its own line (precedent smoke/S394570180-1.md has three). The implementer appends only if a review round asks.

findings.finding: 'names this issue' is indexical in a spec inherited from parent S395289629-1; child vs parent key is ambiguous.
findings.answer: The marker names the child S395289629-5 (the leaf doing the work), confirmed by sibling smoke/S393243811-5.md. Do not write the parent '-1' key.
